description: 🚀 Join our team for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer! We're building an exciting, interactive platform that makes space education fun through astronaut missions, challenges, and simulations. Looking for passionate and creative teammates interested in programming, UI/UX design, game development, animation, research, or content creation. Beginners are welcome! If you're curious about space, love innovation, and enjoy teamwork, let's collaborate and inspire the next generation of astronauts.
